Class SimplePOJOTestDriver

de.learnlib.driver.reflect.SimplePOJOTestDriver
All Implemented Interfaces:
SUL<MethodInput,MethodOutput>
public final class SimplePOJOTestDriver extends ContextExecutableInputSUL<MethodInput,MethodOutput,Object>
A test driver for plain old java objects. Given a constructor of a Java Class, this SUL creates objects of the respective class and invokes methods on these objects as specified in the respective addInput methods.
